_about: What each offer covers, for pieces that introduce a service or quote a price (Talha, 17 November 2026: show in detail what it covers, practically showing the work, before the name and the price). Each item's text is word for word from the What you get list on the offer's page at financedepartmentllc.com (claim FD-31). title is the on-screen title, say the spoken words where narration needs them, scene the work shown (tools/studio/work.py). recap names the offer after its items. hook is a line from the page that may open a piece; it never quotes a price, because the coverage comes first. prices are the figures that make a piece quote this offer. hold says when the offer may not be posted yet. When an offer page's What you get list changes, change this file in the same chat; node tools/coverage.mjs --check <path to the financedepartment repo> compares them.
